The wood grain texture appears somewhat smudged and repetitive, lacking the fine, random detail of real weathered wood. It has a 'painted-on' look common in AI generations.

The metal bands securing the signs to the post are physically ambiguous. They appear to merge into the wood without clear depth or tension, and the connection points on the signs are vague rather than showing distinct holes or clamps.
